fields.evidence: NoesisGameUI.dll+0x442F80 (Toolkit, VMXDataSingletonComponent::CreateVM(EntityHandle const&)) hashes the EntityHandle key modulo the bucket count at this+8, inserts the key, allocates a gui::VMCombat (Noesis::BaseObject::operator_new(0x68)) and stores it in the values storage at this+0x30 (stride 8, capacity at this+0x38); the IndexedStorage assert names the value type Noesis::Ptr<gui::VMCombat> (intrusive ref-counted pointer, 8 bytes, written as void*). The game's methods call these entries '...Object' (InternalGetCombatObject, RemoveCombatObject). HashMap = HashSet of keys (StaticArray<int32> buckets +0, Array<int32> NextIds +0x10, Array<key> Keys +0x20) followed by the values storage +0x30 (pointer + count at +0x38); live samples show exactly that shape (bucket counts 0x13/0x1D/0xC1/0x607 at +8, cap/size pairs at +0x18/+0x28, value count at +0x38). registry size 64 (coverage.json)

summary: Client UI (Noesis) registry: one view-model object per registered combat entity, keyed by the entity; created and removed by gui::registration::VMCombatRegistrationSystem (Update NoesisGameUI.dll+0x444AB0). Lives as a singleton from game start (seen in idle, act1-idle and level-change samples).
open_questions: Values are Noesis::Ptr<gui::VMCombat>; Script Extender has no binding for Noesis view-model classes, so they are exposed as void*.
